reads.AORT: mixed — a real EBITDA re-inflection and live pipeline against a guidance cut, an 82% forward-EPS collapse, above-peer leverage and an On-X recall.
reads.BRBR: strongly-bearish — margin and absolute EBITDA both collapsed on structural input-cost/competition pressure, with consensus still cutting and pricing-repair unproven.
reads.CNXC: mixed — record absolute EBITDA and a real up-market mix shift sit against 4.1x leverage, a $1.5B impairment and hard forward cuts.
reads.EPAM: mixed — a net-cash, FCF-positive grower at a floor multiple, but three cut guides and North America erosion leave the transition unproven.
reads.FUBO: mixed — a large idiosyncratic de-rate and contractual EBITDA step-up against a ~$400M cash burn on $230M cash with collapsing FY26 estimates.
reads.IT: mixed — a franchise-intact, cash-generative subscription model de-rated on a genuine growth inflection that is real but plausibly cyclical/federal-driven, not yet clearly terminal.
reads.MVST: strongly-bearish — an explicit going-concern doubt with a ~$104M sub-12-month maturity wall, negative operating cash flow, and 24% volume decline.
reads.NCNO: mixed — genuine EBITDA/ACV inflection and a below-peer forward multiple offset by sub-peer ~10% growth, thin GAAP earnings, and a steady one-year bleed.
reads.NFLX: mixed — a self-funding, high-ROIC compounder with a long stated runway, but decelerating growth and negative revisions repricing a long-duration expectation.
reads.SMPL: mixed — solid balance sheet and category growth versus broad share loss, a 24.6% Atkins decline and a $391.9M brand impairment.
reads.UBER: mixed — a genuinely accelerating, cash-generative operating engine set against falling headline GAAP earnings, cut forward estimates, and a trailing-only multiple.
reads.V: strongly-bullish — durable double-digit volume/VAS/Visa Direct growth on rising ~30% ROIC with a self-funding balance sheet; the premium is largely earned, not residual.
reads.VITL: mixed — an intact, un-levered, still-growing franchise with elastic demand, offset by a ~97% forward-EBITDA collapse and cash burn whose fix is deferred to 2027.
reads.VRRM: mixed — a genuine growing Government franchise and self-funding cash flow offset against a quantified >10%-revenue customer loss, an impairment and repeatedly cut guidance.
